title: IRT/RTSM UAT tracker
summary: Record test outcomes, trace requirements, manage defects and review a reproducible go-live gate for an IRT/RTSM build. Upload client-neutral test scripts, requirements and an optional defect log through guided column mapping. Complete workspace export retains all edited tests, defects, traceability and computed gate evidence; a responsible reviewer still grants approval.
try: Upload your test scripts, traceability and optional defect log, or start by downloading blank templates.
Record results, retest fixes and trace uncovered requirements. Save the complete workspace to retain every editable table.
Load the fictional example to explore the documented RAND-04 and SUP-03 scenarios.

screenshot.alt: The UAT tracker on first load: the Start here guide with the color key and three things to try; five KPI boxes reading 29 test scripts, 22 passed, 2 failed (RAND-04 and SUP-03), 3 open defects and 97% of requirements traced; the start of the test-script table; and the go-live gate reading NOT ready - blocked, its first criterion naming RAND-04 and COH-03.
screenshot.caption: The explicitly loaded fictional example. Your own study starts from the blank data setup; the app follows the site’s light or dark theme.
